chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said to al-Walīd ibn Ṣabīḥ:
O Walid, do not buy anything for me from a muḥārif, for there is no blessing in associating with him.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.بَرَكَةَ: divine blessing and benefit placed in a matter
key_terms.خُلْطَتَهُ: association, mixing, or dealing with him
key_terms.مُحَارَفٍ: a person engaged in corrupt, deviant, or unlawful earning

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام forbid buying through a person of corrupt earnings?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs avoiding transactions through a person whose earnings or dealings are corrupt or blameworthy. It emphasizes that association with such a person lacks barakah, highlighting moral caution in matters of livelihood and trade.
